title: Troll Stronghold
start: Talk to Commander Denulth at the Burthorpe training camp.

items.t: Climbing boots, rock climbing boots or 12 coins to buy the climbing boots.

recommended.t: Reducing ranged attacks from Thrower Trolls

kills.t: Twig and/or Berry (Level 70) (only if you fail to pickpocket them)

rewards.t: Two mysterious lamps that give 10,000 experience in any skill level 30 or above.
Access to Trollheim and the Troll Stronghold
Access to God Wars Dungeon with the requirement of 60 Agility or 60 Strength.

steps.t: Talk to Commander Denulth in Burthorpe, east of the castle. [Chat: 1 How goes your fight with the trolls? › 2 Is there anything I can do to help? › Accept]

sub.t: If Denulth tells you that the ambush is still being planned, try asking him about the White Knights first. [Chat: 3 I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia.]

p: The route map marks dangerous sections during the quest.

steps.t: If you don't own climbing boots, buy them from Freda [Chat: 3 Can I buy some Climbing boots? › 1 Buy standard boots for 12gp.]
Enter Sabbot's cave from Death Plateau and cross all the obstacles to reach the exit of the tunnel (recommended for low Defence and Constitution levels).

sub.t: Alternatively, take the shortcut by running through the Death Plateau on the surface, clockwise around it, and climbing the rocks to the northwest, then climb the cliffside while wearing climbing boots. Beware of level 67 thrower trolls - Protect from Ranged, Dive, and Fremennik round shield are advised when taking this route.

steps.t: Exit the cavern, climb the rocks to the immediate west of the exit and follow the path east over the rocks until you reach the arena entrance.
Open the arena entrance and attempt to leave through the northern entrance.
Defeat Dad after he attempts to attack you. You may choose to kill him or spare him after defeating him.

sub.t: An easy way to kill Dad safely is to bring him over to the northern entrance or down by the southern rocks and safespot him.
Very low level players may need food.

steps.t: Exit through the north arena entrance.
p: The route map marks dangerous sections during this section.

steps.t: Follow the path north-west, go through the cave to the north and go outside.
Once outside, continue the path to the stronghold to the north and west; thrower trolls can be dealt with by:

sub.t: Taking agility shortcuts around them with level 47 Agility. The cliffside shortcut may be used to avoid the thrower trolls completely.
Running counter-clockwise around the mountain, past the thrower trolls (not behind them: they are supposed to throw rocks at you automatically) to the west.
Use Dive to quickly run past them.
Equip Fremennik round shield to reduce their damage greatly.

steps.t: Look for a dungeon on your minimap northeast of the Troll Stronghold, and enter the cave entrance.
Run south, go through the open wooden door, then continue north.
Kill a troll general and take the prison key. You can safespot with magic, ranged, or necromancy behind the counter.
Head back towards the entrance, past the door and go down the stone staircase to the north.
Unlock the Prison Door to the immediate east and head down the stone staircase.
Open the exit to the south and enter the secret entrance.
Pickpocket (or kill) Twig and Berry. Safespot them inside one of the open cells if needed.
Take the cell keys and unlock the two jail cells to free the prisoners.
p: The sleeping guards who hold the cell keys.

steps.t: Talk to Dunstan, the blacksmith in north-eastern Burthorpe.
